observation: No paper measures cross-modal dependence per denoising step in a unified model that generates both text and image tokens (primer-multimodal.md; novelty audit 2026-10-14; full-text check of VRCD, VIG-Sampler, PUNT).
claim: H-A (P5a): on UniDisc 1.4B under plain sampling at temperature 1 after a COCO prefix, the per-position model cross-modal dependence S_theta (mixture-reference estimator) is front-loaded: composition-standardised early/late ratio >= 1.5 in both directions (pooled and complete-case).
mechanisms: layout and object decisions are made early and couple the modalities; alternatives: entropy profile, token-type composition, confidence position rule, bf16 floor
falsifier: section 2 (f) of research/preregistration/EXP-001-crossmodal-unidisc.md (v0.5, signed): both standardised ratios' 97.5% upper limits < 1.5 and R_Q2 fails, with h inside [0.85, 1.18]

observation: Joint commitment of text and image tokens pays a cross-modal factorisation term E_fact^X (framework-v2 section C); DAPD 2603.12996 avoids coupled tokens in single-modality text.
claim: H-B (P5b): at matched forward passes and per-window token budgets, a dependence-aware schedule (DA) raises matched-minus-shuffled CLIP lift over joint commitment (J) at k0; primary H-B1 DA - J > 0, MEI 1.0 point.
mechanisms: avoided co-commitment of dependent pairs; alternatives: text-earlier (TFJ), placement (DA-low), diversity-driven lift, image density
falsifier: Holm-adjusted H-B1 null with all gates passed, per section 10.2 of research/preregistration/EXP-001-crossmodal-unidisc.md (v0.5, signed)

observation: A measurement is useful to the review only if it predicts where separation helps.

falsifier: rho_strat < 0.5 or rho_strat(M) - rho_strat(E) lower 90% limit <= 0, section 10.3 of research/preregistration/EXP-001-crossmodal-unidisc.md (v0.5, signed)

observation: Paper 2 ideation 2026-10-27, Idea 1 (research/paper2/ideation/IDEAS-RAW-2026-10-27.md): no work found that remasks corrupted conditioning (input) tokens from another modality in unified masked diffusion models; closest are Dropout Decoding (NeurIPS 2025, AR LVLMs, continuous tokens) and output remasking (ReMDM, T2M 2604.18738). E1.
claim: GATE: on UniDisc 1.4B, a PMI reliability score from K complementary mask passes separates corrupted from clean conditioning image tokens (AUROC >= 0.80 for token-swap/occlusion) and gating them to [MASK] recovers >= 30% of the corruption-induced caption-quality drop at matched passes, above a random gate of equal size.
mechanisms: M1 detection + marginalisation; M2 masking regularises (gain on clean too); M3 texture detector not corruption detector; M4 CLIPScore artefact (CIDEr flat)
falsifier: AUROC < 0.75 on token-swap, or recovery < 10% / not above random gate (paired bootstrap CI includes 0)

observation: Omni-Diffusion (arXiv:2603.06577v2 Sec. 3.4, E2) patches repeated top/bottom image patterns with a hand-set position penalty; text MDMs show boundary-first decoding (2508.13021, E1). Paper 2 ideation 2026-10-27, Idea 2.
claim: Text-initialised unified MDMs (Omni-Diffusion, MMaDA) commit first and last image rows early (boundary-row excess >= 1.5x in first 10% of steps) while from-scratch UniDisc does not; null-prompt positional prior calibration lowers a top-bottom duplication index without lowering CLIPScore at matched steps.
mechanisms: M1 inherited text boundary/EOS prior; M2 image delimiter tokens; M3 parallel commit of far tokens with similar marginals; M4 CFG amplification
falsifier: boundary-row excess < 1.5x in every text-initialised model, or equally present in UniDisc; duplication index not reduced (CI includes 0)
